units.source_text: 诱饵还是按先前的老样子穿在上面。

en.t: The bait was still threaded onto it in the same old way as before.

units.source_text: 鱼腐烂的臭味直冲鼻管。

en.t: The stink of rotting fish shot straight up his nose.

units.source_text: 架设好“希望”陷阱，已经两个多星期了，仍旧一点反应都没有。

en.t: More than two weeks had passed since he set up the trap called Hope, yet there was still no response at all.

units.source_text: 究竟什么地方有问题呢？

en.t: Where on earth was the problem?

units.source_text: 对陷阱的构造，他是有信心的。

en.t: He had confidence in the construction of the trap.

units.source_text: 只要那些乌鸦去叼诱饵，那它就绝对会成为自己的囊中物。

en.t: As long as those crows came to peck at the bait, it would certainly fall into his hands.

units.source_text: 但是，首先无法让乌鸦回过头来看一眼诱饵，这才没有着落……

en.t: But first he could not even get the crows to turn and glance at the bait, and that was why nothing was getting anywhere...
